page_title: LIV 3-1 BUR | Liverpool v Burnley 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+7' That will be all from Alexis Mac Allister who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Bobby Clark (Liverpool).
90+7' Today's match ends for Andrew Robertson who will be replaced by Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool).
90+7' Here is a change. Wataru Endo is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to James McConnell (Liverpool).
90+6' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+6' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at James Trafford, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
90+5' A long pass finds Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
90+3' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking David Datro Fofana (Burnley), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
90+3' James Trafford (Burnley) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
90' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
88' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
86' It will be a substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is ready to enter the pitch as Zeki Amdouni walks off.
86' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
82' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) replacing Luis Diaz.
81' Aaron Ramsey comes off the pitch to be replaced by Han-Noah Massengo (Burnley).
80' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Maxime Esteve will be replaced by Vitinho (Burnley).
79' 3 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Harvey Elliott is pounced on by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool). His close-range header flashes past James Trafford and into the left of the goal. 3:1.
79' The resulting corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared.

79' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.

75' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom right corner, but James Trafford keeps it out.
74' Tim Robinson interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Lorenz Assignon (Burnley). Liverpool have a free kick.
73' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
72' Close! Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
71' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

71' Great save! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by James Trafford. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' A yellow card is awarded to Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).

67' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
66' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Tim Robinson had a clear view and blows his whistle.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.
65' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was!
64' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Caoimhin Kelleher.
64' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
62' Andrew Robertson is the provider with a good cross and Diogo Jota (Liverpool) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he fires a shot well wide of the left post.
60' The Liverpool players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
59' He should have scored! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
59' The resulting corner, taken by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool), comes to nothing.
57' The ball is cleared after Diogo Jota (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
55' Vincent Kompany isn't happy on the touchline after referee Tim Robinson shows him a yellow card.
55' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Tim Robinson signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Liverpool players celebrate.
53' The Liverpool players halt their celebrations as referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
52' 2 - 1 Luis Diaz (Liverpool) leaps to connect with a lovely cross and scores with a header that bounces off the ground and goes inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.

51' Liverpool slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
51' The attendance for today's match is 59896.

50' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
49' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is about to take a corner kick.

49' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Jurgen Klopp makes a half-time substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) comes on in place of Trent Alexander-Arnold.
46' The whistle blows and Tim Robinson starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is hurriedly cleared.

45+3' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' 1 - 1 The ball was swung towards the box by Josh Brownhill from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Dara O'Shea (Burnley), who planted a powerful header into the top right corner of the net to make the score 1:1.
45' The referee awards a corner and Josh Brownhill (Burnley) goes over to take it.
45' A pass into the penalty area from Josh Brownhill (Burnley) is intercepted by the defence.

44' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. James Trafford guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

43' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
40' Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
39' Jurgen Klopp is stunned as referee Tim Robinson shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
38' A fine pass finds Luis Diaz (Liverpool) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the James Trafford reacts superbly to deny him.
36' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
36' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tim Robinson signals.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Wataru Endo (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' 1 - 0 Diogo Jota (Liverpool) leaps highest to meet a perfectly taken free kick and steers his header past the helpless goalkeeper.
31' Corner kick. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is ready to send the ball into the box.
29' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), but James Trafford is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
29' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
28' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
27' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
26' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) is punished with the yellow card.

26' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tim Robinson stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Free kick. Liverpool will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

26' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
25' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
20' The free kick is taken by Aaron Ramsey (Burnley), but ball is cleared.
19' Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
16' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
14' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
14' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
12' The resulting corner from Josh Brownhill (Burnley) comes to nothing.
11' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find Darwin Nunez, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
10' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Caoimhin Kelleher.
7' Crossbar! David Datro Fofana (Burnley) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
4' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
2' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Caoimhin Kelleher.
1' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) commits a foul and Tim Robinson immediately signals a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Burnley will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson was nominated as the referee for this game.
